name: qa-flake-triage
description: Flaky test triage: find the condition a flake depends on, quarantine it with an expiry date, fix known flake patterns, and track flake rates. Agents (e2e-flake-bisector, regression-bisector) rerun a test under varied conditions with a shared-state isolation stage, and run git bisect to find the commit that introduced a regression, with a perf-measurement mode.
